g.text: Bars: pooled means; orange diamonds: pooled p95; black ticks: each round's mean. Dashed line: 5 ms.
Same-socket physical cores; two reversed-order rounds; first 30 frames excluded per run.
64 x 64: 360 frames/run; 128 x 128: 120 frames/run. Panels use different y scales.
